title: 第23章 准备坑人第24章 狂吃土的两个倒霉蛋
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“老程，这件事我先不亲自掺和，林东方要的那一堆厨房用品我要亲自打造。”
张大锤前阵子收完那两个留学生就开始捣鼓一件法宝，结果‘酿成大错’
他现在想要挽回一下！
程大发点点头，然后回御兽峰去弄鸡了。
张大锤想了一会，他虽然腾不出手亲自掺和，但是可以让他的宝贝徒弟去添把火。
“怎么也要从那两个小兔崽子身上坑出来百万灵石才对得起林东方啊！”
“二虎，你把你的师弟们都叫来，除了周长青和任健。”
张大锤把他的亲传大弟子王二虎叫了进来。
王二虎人如其名，长的好似两头老虎那么魁梧。
身高将近一丈，浑身肌肉疙疙瘩瘩的。
背后背着两把大锤。
他瓮声瓮气的答道，“俺这就去叫他们。”
不多时，剩下三个亲传弟子走了进来。
张大锤笑眯眯的问他们，“你们最近和任健以及周长青相处的如何？”
“回师父，徒儿谨遵教诲，没有和他们过多接触！”
“每日相见不过一面，说话不超过五十个字。”
“师父，什么时候可以把他们弄出去啊。”
三人老老实实的回答。
张大锤先前就叮嘱过他们不要和那两人过多接触，毕竟是来留学的。
张大锤生怕他这炼器手艺被那俩人偷学了去。

“不错，你们四个把这块肉分了，这块肉是林东方煮的。”
等到四人吃完肉，感应到识海内的禁制之后，都骇然失色。
“师父，那周长青和任健得罪了林东方，会不会导致我炼器峰以后分不到肉啊！”
一个弟子脸色苦了起来。
“无妨，为师今天把林东方需要的厨具打造出来，你们以后可要对那两人好一些。”
“师父，此话怎讲？”
“你们可以对他们热情一些，帮他们一些鸡毛蒜皮的小事，但他们想要你们去针对林东方，可万万不能答应。”
“师父，我们现在哪还敢得罪林东方，这您放心吧。”
“你们知道林东方现在的宝贝程度就好，你们要让那两人觉得我们炼器峰是把他们当做自己人一样，最好让他们叫来几个狐朋狗友一起来炼器峰拜师，为师自有道理。”
四个弟子面面相觑，实在想不通张大锤想搞什么鬼。
但也只能点头。
王二虎闷声道，“那我们多和那两个小子多喝酒就行了，师父，您在我们四个识海里再加点禁制，我怕喝多了失言。”
张大锤笑着点点头，“还是二虎聪明，来，为师给你们下点禁制，等那两人利用完了再给你们解开。”
下完了禁制，四人转身离开，买酒买菜去了。
喝酒吹牛，这些他们在行。
现在有禁制在身，他们暂时无法说出和林东方有关的话题。
被人问起林东方他们只能回答不知道，不了解。
张大锤想了一会之后，直接传令给万宝峰神兵楼，让原来的那个管事滚蛋。
神兵楼一直都是炼器峰负责，所以那天任健和周长青才觉得自己能在那里拿捏林东方。
张大锤又召唤来一位已经出师的弟子，对他严肃道，

“你记住，神兵楼是给瑶池圣地弟子提供武器的地方，东西有就是有，没有就说没有，别自己在脸上加戏。”
content_en:
"Lao Cheng, I won't get involved in this matter myself. I will make the pile of kitchen supplies that Lin Dongfang wants."
Zhang Dachui started tinkering with a magic weapon after taking in the two international students a while ago, but it turned out to be a "big mistake"
He wants to save it now!
Cheng Dafa nodded and went back to Yushou Peak to get some chicken.
Zhang Dachui thought for a while. Although he couldn't spare any time to intervene personally, he could let his precious apprentice add fuel to the fire.
"I have to dig out millions of spiritual stones from those two little bastards to be worthy of Lin Dongfang!"
"Er Hu, please call all your junior brothers here, except Zhou Changqing and Ren Jian."
Zhang Dachui called in his personal disciple Wang Erhu.
As the name suggests, Wang Erhu looks like two tigers.
He is nearly a foot tall and has muscles all over his body.
Carrying two sledgehammers behind his back.
He replied angrily, "I'll call them right away."
Not long after, the remaining three direct disciples walked in.
Zhang Dachui asked them with a smile, "How are you getting along with Ren Jian and Zhou Changqing recently?"
"Back to Master, my disciple followed the instructions carefully and did not have too much contact with them!"
"We only meet once a day, and we don't speak more than fifty words each day."
"Master, when can we get them out?"
The three of them answered honestly.
Zhang Dachui had previously told them not to have too much contact with those two people. After all, they were here to study abroad.
Zhang Dachui was afraid that his weapon-making skills would be stolen from those two people.
"Yes, you four divided this piece of meat. This piece of meat was cooked by Lin Dongfang."
After the four of them finished eating the meat and sensed the restriction in the sea of consciousness, they all turned pale with horror.
"Master, if Zhou Changqing and Ren Jian offend Lin Dongfang, will it cause me to lose my share of meat at the Weapon Refining Peak in the future?"
One of the disciples looked bitter.
"It doesn't matter, I will make the kitchen utensils that Lin Dongfang needs today. You should be nicer to those two people in the future."
"Master, how do you say this?"
"You can be more enthusiastic towards them and help them with trivial things, but if they want you to target Lin Dongfang, you must not agree."
"Master, how dare we offend Lin Dongfang now? Don't worry."
"As long as you know how precious Lin Dongfang is now, you want to make those two people feel that we at Weapon Refining Peak treat them as one of our own. It's best for them to call a few friends to come to Weapon Refining Peak to become their master. It makes sense for them to be teachers."
The four disciples looked at each other and couldn't figure out what Zhang Dachui wanted to do.
But he could only nod.
Wang Erhu said in a muffled voice, "Then let's just drink more with those two boys. Master, please add some restrictions on our four seas of consciousness. I'm afraid I'll make a mistake after drinking too much."
Zhang Dachui smiled and nodded, "Er Hu is still smart, come on, I will put some restrictions on you, and I will unlock them for you after those two have finished using them."
After placing the ban, the four of them turned around and left to buy wine and groceries.
They are good at drinking and bragging.
Now that there is a restriction, they cannot talk about topics related to Lin Dongfang for the time being.
When asked about Lin Dongfang, they could only answer that they didn't know or didn't understand.
After Zhang Dachui thought for a while, he directly sent an order to the Wanbaofeng Shenbing Building to tell the original manager to get out.
The Weapon Refining Peak has always been in charge of the Shenbing Building, so that day Ren Jian and Zhou Changqing felt that they could control Lin Dongfang there.
Zhang Dachui summoned another disciple who had already graduated and said seriously to him,
"Remember, the Divine Weapon Building is a place that provides weapons to the disciples of the Yaochi Holy Land. If you have something, you have it. If you don't have it, just say you don't have it. Don't make it look on your face."
